0.original: Laxio of Little Solace remains unconvinced of your intentions.

1.original: Laxio demands that you obey his every command as proof that you are a friend to the sylphs. First, /poke his back to scratch an itch.

2.original: By touching Laxio, you have been afflicted with a sylphic curse that turns one's skin to moss. /examineself and ascertain its dire effect.

3.original: The curse was a lie; Laxio was only fooling you. Express your adulation and /congratulate him on his brilliant ruse.

4.original: Your sense of humor pleases Laxio, who now welcomes you to Little Solace with wings outspread.

48.original: Walking one may dance many dances, but this one still doesn't like walking ones! Why? Because walking ones don't listen! That's why!

49.original: If walking one wants to be friend to this one, walking one should listen, and listen good! This one has itchy spot on back. Walking one should <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>poke<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> it.

50.original: This one has itchy spot on back. Walking one should <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>poke<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> it. And not too hard! This one has sensitive fibers.

51.original: Tee hee! Walking one fell into trap! Touching this one turns walking ones' skin into moss!

52.original: Tee hee! Mossy one's skin turns greener and greener! Mossy one should <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>examine self<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to see how silly mossy one has become!
